headline: AM Best Assigns Issue Credit Rating to The Travelers Companies, Inc. New Senior Unsecured Notes
summary: OLDWICK, N.J., July 24, 2026--AM Best has assigned a Long-Term Issue Credit Rating of "a+" (Excellent) to $750 million 4.95% senior unsecured notes, due July 2031, issued by the Travelers Companies, Inc. (Travelers) (headquartered in New York, NY). The outlook assigned to this Credit Rating (rating) is stable. The net proceeds of the issuance are expected to be used for general corporate purposes.
